decision.title: Phase 5 starts now, alongside the end of Phase 4 (owner)

body.p: on the owner's choice ("Start Phase 5 now"), after they asked for a way to work with XSD schemas in the sxml command. Amends and PLAN.md's order: Phase 5 (XSD 1.1 validation and schema-aware typing) no longer waits for the Phase 4 gate. Its packets are planned in docs/tasks/phase-5.md by a design packet (5.1), which also vendors the W3C XSD test suite () and proposes the gate numbers. The Phase 4 gate still closes Phase 4; Phase 5 work must not regress its counts. A sxml validate command enters the CLI only once it works ().
